name: Higashisefuri (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Higashisefuri village emblem in white: an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former village of Higashisefuri in Saga Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-03-01.

features.role: Higashisefuri village emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised character
